On July 11th, 2025 Israeli settlers in the Occupied West Bank beat Sayfollah Musallet, a 23 year old Palestinian-American to death. They also shot and killed Mohammed al-Shalabi. Where is the NYT’s coverage of this horrific slaughter? Shamefully and hypocritically non-existent. If the roles had been reversed, how many articles do you think the NYT would have written by now? 

Sayfollah Musallet was described as sweet and gentle by his relatives & helped run his family’s recently opened ice cream shop in Tampa, Florida. His father said “He was a beautiful and loving son- a beautiful soul.” Israeli settlers beat Sayfollah unconscious then prevented ambulances from reaching him for hours. By the time Sayfollah was able to be brought to a hospital he had already passed away. (TRT World, Washington Post) 

The NYT is a disgraceful, racist paper that knows exactly what it is doing when it fails to report on Israel’s continuous horrific war cr!mes. Shame on them. 

Stop paying for lies and propaganda: Unsubscribe from the NYT now & tell your friends. ⚠️‼️ #RetractYourLiesNYT
